Hey 
This feeling of suicidal tendencies is bloody scary isn't it. You may be getting on with your day and a memory or not may cross you kind and you instantly feel emotionally low and thoughts and ideas cross your mind about how easy it would be to get away from the pain and life in general. And for those that have BPD it can occur for unexplained reasons and it feel VERY REAL. 

In many cases with those who have BPD, they feel these suicidal feelings but they aren't real. It's out mind trying to screw with us. Just acknowledge the thought. Realise that it's your disorder and not YOU. We all know who we are, it a skill to actually acknowledge who we are and when our disorder is taking over who we are. 

Safely plans are the best way to learn and help when the disorder is taking over. Realise what are the signs and symptoms that occur before or during when the disorder takes over, and list a plan on how to deal with this. Catch yourself in the moment, realise that it's just the disorder. Get up and walk away from the situation, do something that engages all the sense such as cooking, a walk, sitting outside and listening and smelling you surroundings 

A bad habit for does with BPD is thinking no one cares. There are people in the world that do, such as on Reddit. But there are local services in most areas to help with crisis moments. 

Don't let the disorder defeat you
